rules.title: Hardcoded secret
rules.description: A password or secret is written directly in the code. Anyone who can read the code can steal it.

enforcement.message: A password or secret is written directly in the code. Anyone who can read the code can steal it.
required_actions: Load the value from an environment variable or a secrets manager
Rotate the secret if this code was ever shared or committed

rules.title: Cloud or service key in code
rules.description: A real-looking cloud, payment or service key is in the code. Leaked keys are found and abused within minutes.

enforcement.message: A real-looking cloud, payment or service key is in the code. Leaked keys are found and abused within minutes.
required_actions: Remove the key from the code and load it from the environment
Revoke and rotate the key now

rules.title: eval() runs arbitrary code
rules.description: eval() runs any text as code. If that text can come from a user, they can run their own code in your app.

enforcement.message: eval() runs any text as code. If that text can come from a user, they can run their own code in your app.
required_actions: Use JSON.parse() for data
Replace dynamic code with explicit logic or a lookup table

rules.title: Function constructor runs arbitrary code
rules.description: new Function() turns text into code, the same risk as eval().

enforcement.message: new Function() turns text into code, the same risk as eval().
required_actions: Replace dynamic code with explicit functions

rules.title: HTML injected into the page (XSS)
rules.description: Writing raw HTML into the page lets attackers inject scripts if any part of it comes from users.

enforcement.message: Writing raw HTML into the page lets attackers inject scripts if any part of it comes from users.
required_actions: Use textContent for text
Sanitize HTML with a library such as DOMPurify before inserting it

rules.title: React dangerouslySetInnerHTML
rules.description: dangerouslySetInnerHTML skips React's protection against script injection.

enforcement.message: dangerouslySetInnerHTML skips React's protection against script injection.
required_actions: Render text normally in JSX
If HTML is required, sanitize it with DOMPurify first

rules.title: Shell command built from variables (JavaScript)
rules.description: The shell command is built from variables. If one comes from a user, they can run their own commands on your server.

enforcement.message: The shell command is built from variables. If one comes from a user, they can run their own commands on your server.
required_actions: Use execFile/spawn with an argument array instead of a command string
Validate inputs against an allowlist

rules.title: SQL query built from strings (JavaScript)
rules.description: The database query is built by joining strings. Attackers can change the query and read or delete your data.

enforcement.message: The database query is built by joining strings. Attackers can change the query and read or delete your data.
required_actions: Use parameterized queries (placeholders such as ? or $1)
Use your ORM's query builder

rules.title: TLS certificate checks turned off (JavaScript)
rules.description: Certificate checks are disabled, so anyone on the network can intercept this connection.

enforcement.message: Certificate checks are disabled, so anyone on the network can intercept this connection.
required_actions: Remove the override
Add the correct CA certificate instead of disabling checks

rules.title: Weak hash algorithm (JavaScript)
rules.description: MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for security use such as passwords or signatures.

enforcement.message: MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for security use such as passwords or signatures.
required_actions: Use SHA-256 or better for integrity
Use bcrypt, scrypt or Argon2 for passwords

rules.title: eval() or exec() runs arbitrary code (Python)
rules.description: eval()/exec() run any text as Python code. If that text can come from a user, they can take over the program.

enforcement.message: eval()/exec() run any text as Python code. If that text can come from a user, they can take over the program.
required_actions: Use ast.literal_eval() for literals or json.loads() for data
Replace dynamic code with explicit logic

rules.title: Shell command with shell=True (Python)
rules.description: shell=True runs the command through the shell, so special characters in variables can run extra commands.

enforcement.message: shell=True runs the command through the shell, so special characters in variables can run extra commands.
required_actions: Pass the command as a list and drop shell=True
Validate inputs against an allowlist

rules.title: Shell command built from variables (Python)
rules.description: The shell command is built from variables. If one comes from a user, they can run their own commands.

enforcement.message: The shell command is built from variables. If one comes from a user, they can run their own commands.
required_actions: Use subprocess.run() with an argument list
Validate inputs against an allowlist

rules.title: SQL query built from strings (Python)
rules.description: The database query is built from strings. Attackers can change the query and read or delete your data.

enforcement.message: The database query is built from strings. Attackers can change the query and read or delete your data.
required_actions: Pass values as parameters: cursor.execute(sql, (value,))
Use your ORM's query builder

rules.title: Unsafe deserialization (pickle)
rules.description: Loading pickle data can run code hidden inside it. Never unpickle data you didn't create yourself.

enforcement.message: Loading pickle data can run code hidden inside it. Never unpickle data you didn't create yourself.
required_actions: Use JSON for data from users or the network
Sign and verify data if pickle is unavoidable

rules.title: Unsafe YAML loading
rules.description: yaml.load without SafeLoader can create arbitrary Python objects and run code.

enforcement.message: yaml.load without SafeLoader can create arbitrary Python objects and run code.
required_actions: Use yaml.safe_load()

rules.title: TLS certificate checks turned off (Python)
rules.description: Certificate checks are disabled, so anyone on the network can intercept this connection.

enforcement.message: Certificate checks are disabled, so anyone on the network can intercept this connection.
required_actions: Remove verify=False
Point verify at the correct CA bundle instead

rules.title: Weak hash algorithm (Python)
rules.description: MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for security use such as passwords or signatures.

enforcement.message: MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for security use such as passwords or signatures.
required_actions: Use hashlib.sha256() for integrity
Use bcrypt, scrypt or Argon2 for passwords

rules.title: Debug mode enabled in a web app (Python)
rules.description: Debug mode shows internal details and, in Flask, gives an interactive console that can run code.

enforcement.message: Debug mode shows internal details and, in Flask, gives an interactive console that can run code.
required_actions: Turn debug off outside local development
Read the setting from an environment variable

rules.title: JWT signature not verified (Python)
rules.description: The token's signature isn't checked, so anyone can forge a token and log in as anyone.

enforcement.message: The token's signature isn't checked, so anyone can forge a token and log in as anyone.
required_actions: Always verify the signature and pin the allowed algorithms

rules.title: SQL query built from strings (Java)
rules.description: The database query is built by joining strings. Attackers can change the query and read or delete your data.

enforcement.message: The database query is built by joining strings. Attackers can change the query and read or delete your data.
required_actions: Use PreparedStatement with ? placeholders
